name: Beachin’ Eats Food Truck & Catering
description: Beachin’ Burritos is a California-style breakfast burrito shop just a half block from Isla’s famous Playa Norte. We feature a breakfast and lunch menu with delicious burritos such as our Point Break burrito packed with bacon, chorizo, cheddar cheese, 3 eggs, potatoes & salsa roja wrapped in a homemade flour tortilla. Or our delicious chicken burrito with grilled chicken, lettuce, diced tomatoes, black beans, avocado and our homemade salsa roja. We pay attention to every detail—come visit and see for yourself!
